items.title: The monomials of degree at most n form a basis of the n-th filtration layer of the universal Askey-Wilson algebra
items.author: Paul Terwilliger
items.difficulty_reason: The theorem states that the monomials A^i B^j C^k alpha^r beta^s gamma^t of total degree at most n form a basis of the n-th layer of the filtration of the universal Askey-Wilson algebra (statement lines 1349-1358). Independence is cited from the paper's own basis theorem, and the proof then establishes spanning by induction: the layer is generated by words in the seven generators, and the commutation lemma together with centrality of alpha, beta and gamma allows each word to be reordered modulo the previous layer, so only monomials of total degree exactly n have to be added at each step (proof lines 1361-1404). The step that carries the content is the reordering modulo Delta_{n-1}, since it is what converts an arbitrary word into the required monomial shape; the induction itself is then routine. H2.
